summary: Phase 1 Dealer Warranty Parts tested end-to-end (backend + frontend) against owner@isodemo.com. 5/6 backend tests pass; 1 real backend bug found in dealer dedup (regex misuse). Frontend loads all 7 tabs, dashboard cards, dealer/order/allocation modals and settings — no UI blockers.

critical.issue: Same-name dedup does NOT work. Code uses safe_regex(f'^{name}$') which re.escape()s the leading ^ and trailing $, producing regex '\^Name\$' that never matches. A duplicate dealer with identical name creates a new record instead of returning the existing one. Fix: use safe_regex_exact(name) from utils/security_plus.py. Same bug likely present in POST /api/dealer-parts/stores (line 661) for store-name dedup.

integration_issues.issue: dp-alloc-action-* count returned 0 during automated test, though seeded 'Approved' + 'Dispatched' allocations exist and should each show an advance button. Likely just a timing issue during automation (allocs list still loading when count was read); manual verification recommended.

action_items: Fix dealer name dedup: replace safe_regex(f'^{name}$') with safe_regex_exact(name) in routes/dealer_parts.py line 186 (create_dealer) AND line 661 (create_store). Without this, posting the same dealer twice yields duplicate records, contradicting the stated 'never duplicate' requirement.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/dealer_parts.py L186 & L661: safe_regex(f'^{name}$') is broken — re.escape escapes ^ and $, so exact-name lookup never matches. Use safe_regex_exact(name).
dealer_parts.py file is 784 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into sub-routers (dealers, orders, allocations, stores).
Approve endpoint accepts `data: dict = None` with default mutable-ish None — safe here but pydantic model would be more explicit and validated.
receive_allocation always sets status='completed' — the ALLOC_STATUSES list includes 'partially_received' but code has no branch to set it (dead status). Also no per-item received-qty override.
list_dealers uses safe_regex(search) which is a substring $regex — fine for search, but the field query {"name": {...}} implicitly requires case-insensitive index for performance at scale.
seed_data_creation: Test created TEST_DealerA_Jan26, TEST_DealerFlow_Jan26, TEST_UI_Dealer_Jan26 dealers + TEST-ORD-JAN26-* orders + a completed allocation with parts TESTPART-A/B stocked to Main Dealer Store. Not cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend dedup bug is a one-line fix in dealer_parts.py (swap to safe_regex_exact). After the fix, re-run pytest backend/tests/test_dealer_parts_jan2026.py — all 6 should pass. Frontend flows all render; verify dp-alloc-action buttons manually on the Allocations tab (there is at least one Approved and one Dispatched allocation seeded).
rca of the issue: safe_regex() from utils/security_plus.py performs re.escape() on the ENTIRE input including regex anchors. Passing f'^{name}$' results in the anchors being escaped as literal characters ('\^name\$'), so the mongo $regex never matches any stored document. The utils file exposes safe_regex_exact() which is the intended helper for whole-string matches — the developer picked the wrong helper. Reproduction: POST /api/dealer-parts/dealers twice with identical name+country → second call returns a NEW id instead of the existing one.
